speech_wps._about: Words per second at TTS speed 1.0, used only to estimate timing before a voice exists. Measured values replace these after `mvf voice`. en 3.2 measured on a cloned narrator, 2026-10-27 (estimate 33.4 s vs measured 27.2 s at 2.6).
